TO ARMS!

By decree of Commander Avenmoor, all stout and able-bodied citizens are hereby summoned to lend their strength in service of the realm.

The Arch-Purifier calls upon warriors and sworn blades to uncover the foul origins of the dreaded Warhelm Curse. This duty is not for the meek nor untested-it is reserved for veterans, proven mercenaries, and those whose courage can withstand the shadow of the undeath.

Let it be known: only the formidable shall be chosen.

Stand Ready. Serve with Honor. For Greater Glory.
